sourceAuthority: Room identity, exits, observed objects, actions, turns and save/restore remain engine-controlled.
scope: Unchanged retained GLB with separately sampled hidden floors, normal perspective room views at 1.6 m eye height, drag-to-look and bounded WASD/touch walking. Optional overview is turn-free.
limitation: Existing single-view texture projection remains visible at eye level; no visual mesh, UV or polygon repair is claimed.
